AUTOSAR e2e property returns None when attribute exists

#### Description

When accessing the `e2e` property on AUTOSAR message specifics, it returns `None` even when the end-to-end protection properties should be available. This affects messages that have valid e2e configurations in ARXML files.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

# Load ARXML file with e2e properties
db = cantools.db.load_file('tests/files/arxml/system-4.2.arxml')

# Get a message that should have e2e properties
msg = db.get_message_by_name('Message3')

# This should return the e2e properties but returns None instead
print(msg.autosar.e2e)  # Expected: AutosarEnd2EndProperties object, Actual: None

# Same issue with other messages
msg1 = db.get_message_by_name('Message1') 
print(msg1.autosar.e2e)  # Expected: AutosarEnd2EndProperties object, Actual: None
```

The issue also affects the output of the list command, where e2e properties are not displayed in message details even when they should be present in the ARXML file.
</issue>
